name: Summer Day Camp
description_short: A town-run summer day camp for ages 6-12 (grouped 6-7, 8-9 and 10-12), Monday to Friday 8:30am-4:30pm, run by Johnston Parks and Recreation. Up to 80 campers; 2026 registration closed when the camp filled.
